facts.fact: The OTR Commissaire General says digitisation of land-title archives, begun in 2012, reached 99.32% by end January 2020, with a database available for checks on properties and charges.
Togo Officiel says the process of obtaining land titles is fully dematerialised through an online portal handling all cadastre procedures.

Togo First reports that the land process has been digitised through the Guichet unique du foncier, and that since 17 August 2026 surveyors must send georeferenced parcel plans online to it via the OTR site.

systems.system: Agence nationale du domaine et du foncier (ANDF)
systems.owner: Ministry of land affairs and Ministry of Finance

facts.fact: An African Development Bank-posted notice under the PAGDSP seeks a firm to develop the Land Information System (SIF) application at the Office Togolais des Recettes, on the LADM model, with mobile GIS, links to tax and civil-status systems and skills transfer to OTR staff.

A CAGECFI press release carried by Lomé Gazette says the digitisation of Togo's land books and a new land business application were delivered to the DCCF on 3 December 2025, with the DCCF director saying manual title creation was stopped and use of the application would start the following Monday.
